pack.name: VYUHA Data Pack
pack.policy: Public-domain Government of India and authoritative open sources only. No classified or restricted data. Every parameter carries a source record.

confidence_classes.published-spec: Value appears in an official government / PSU published document
confidence_classes.govt-release: Value reported from a government press release or trial announcement
confidence_classes.parliament: Value from a Lok Sabha / Rajya Sabha answer
confidence_classes.open-research: Authoritative non-government open dataset or peer-reviewed literature
confidence_classes.assumption: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION BY THE TEAM - shown in RED in the provenance panel

G1.note: Official weight taxonomy and Green/Yellow/Red zone definitions.

G2.doc: Interactive airspace map (Green / Yellow / Red zones)
G2.note: PIB backgrounder states the airspace map is freely available without login.

G3.doc: Certified RPAS list (type certified and enlisted UAS models)
G3.note: Real UAS models operating in Indian airspace - used for the FRIENDLY / CIVILIAN library, not invented models.

G4.doc: Rajya Sabha / Lok Sabha answers on registered UAS and type certificates
G4.note: 96+ UAS type certificates; 29,500+ registered drones with state-wise distribution.

G5.org: Bharat Electronics Limited (Defence PSU, Ministry of Defence)
G5.note: D4 configuration: radar detection & tracking, EO (CCD + IR + LRF), RF detection & jamming, GPS jamming/spoofing, laser DEW, C3.

G6.note: Radar detection ~4 km, jamming ~2 km, laser kill ~1-2.5 km as publicly reported. Used as a CALIBRATION BASELINE, not a certified specification.

G7.doc: Request for Information - Air Defence Fire Control Radar - Drone Detector (ADFCR-DD), Aug 2025
G7.note: Official task chain: detect, track, CLASSIFY and neutralise - from fighters down to small low-RCS drones.

G8.org: DRDO - Centre for High Energy Systems & Sciences (CHESS)
G8.doc: IDD&IS Mk-II (10 kW) and Mk-IIA / Sahastra Shakti (30 kW) public trial releases
G8.note: 10 kW laser ~2 km; 30 kW trials engaged a fixed-wing UAV at long range and deterred a 7-drone swarm (13 Apr 2025).

G9.doc: RFP for a 50-drone swarm (>70% indigenous content)
G9.note: Swarm size envelope used to bound the procedural swarm generator.

G10.doc: Public API reference - present weather codes, visibility, temperature, dew point
G10.note: Weather codes 11/12/40-49 are fog and ice-fog states. Drives the atmospheric transmission model.

G11.org: ISRO - National Remote Sensing Centre (Bhuvan / NOEDA)
G11.doc: CartoDEM 1 arc-second DEM, Resourcesat LISS-III / AWiFS, LULC
G11.note: Free download of CartoDEM (20 tiles/day) and Resourcesat products. Drives terrain masking and clutter.

G12.note: 791 drone incursions on the western border in 2025 (9 J&K IB, 782 Punjab/Rajasthan IB); 237 neutralised - 5 with war-like stores, 72 with narcotics, 161 without payload.

G13.org: Ministry of Home Affairs / Bureau of Civil Aviation Security
G13.doc: Directive mandating counter-UAS deployment at civil airports
G13.note: Justifies the civil critical-infrastructure scenario pack.

G16.org: Ministry of Defence / Defence Acquisition Council
G16.doc: Public procurement releases (23 x IDD&IS ~ Rs 400 crore; 16 x IDD&IS Mk-II for Army and IAF)
G16.note: Per-system unit cost used for the Cost-of-Exchange curve.

O1.note: Realistic friendly air traffic for IFF and deconfliction drills.

O2.org: eBird / Zoological Survey of India (open data)
O2.note: Realistic bird clutter for false-alarm training.

O3.org: NASA Ames Research Center - Human Performance Group
O3.note: Validated 6-axis workload instrument; developed over 40+ laboratory simulations, cited in 4,400+ studies.

O5.doc: Drone RF fingerprinting - 2.4 / 5.8 GHz FHSS control links
O5.note: Control-link band, hop rate and protocol family priors for the RF detector.

O6.doc: Swerling target fluctuation models, small-UAS radar cross-section, Johnson criteria, ground clutter sigma-naught
O6.note: Provides the fluctuation model, the RCS priors per class, the Johnson-criteria pixel counts and the clutter coefficient class values.

zones.label: Green
zones.note: No permission required for civil operation; AD engagement authorised inside a declared AD bubble.

zones.label: Yellow
zones.note: ATC clearance zone. Engagement requires explicit C2 authorisation - deconfliction mandatory.

zones.label: Red
zones.note: No-drone zone. Kinetic engagement prohibited in this trainer's ROE model - soft-kill or escalation to higher HQ only.

peak_power_w.note: Portable Ku-band drone-detection radar class. ASSUMPTION.

antenna_gain_db.note: ASSUMPTION - typical phased / mechanically scanned panel.

integration_gain_db.note: Coherent integration over ~8 dwells. Without it a 0.01 m2 micro-drone is undetectable at any useful range.

scan_period_s.note: ASSUMPTION - sets the minimum detection latency.

max_range_m.note: Publicly reported D4 radar detection range - used as the calibrated ceiling.

clutter_coeff.note: Residual ground-clutter sigma-naught AFTER Doppler/MTI processing. A micro-drone is a genuinely hard target - see the calibration note in the provenance panel.

max_range_m.note: Publicly reported D4 jamming/detection envelope class - calibrated ceiling.

pol_loss_db.note: ASSUMPTION - polarisation mismatch on a tumbling airframe.

px_required_class.note: Johnson-criteria class: pixels across target for reliable CLASSIFICATION.

px_required_detect.note: Johnson-criteria class: pixels across target for DETECTION.

px_required_id.note: Johnson-criteria class: pixels across target for reliable IDENTIFICATION.

ref_range_m.note: ASSUMPTION - reference acquisition range for a commercial quad.

path_exponent.note: ASSUMPTION - spherical spreading plus excess attenuation.

effectors.label: Monitor / Passive Track
effectors.note: No action. Correct when the threat is outside the defended area and time permits.

effectors.label: Warn (loudhailer / visual / dazzle)
effectors.note: Lowest-cost escalation. Effective on a cooperative operator.

effectors.label: Directional RF Jammer (soft kill)
effectors.note: RF control-link denial. USELESS against autonomous / fibre-optic threats.

effectors.label: GNSS Jam / Spoof (soft kill)
effectors.note: Navigation denial. Requires the target to be GNSS-dependent.

effectors.label: Interceptor / Net UAV (non-lethal)
effectors.note: Kinetic capture. Too slow against a diving FPV.

effectors.label: AD Gun / RWS 7.62-12.7 mm (hard kill)
effectors.note: Highest collateral risk. Prohibited over populated ground in this ROE model.

effectors.label: Laser DEW 10 kW (hard kill)
effectors.note: 10 kW class, ~2 km - publicly reported IDD&IS Mk-II envelope. Weather sensitive.

threats.label: Commercial quadcopter (recon)
threats.note: 161 of the 237 drones neutralised in 2025 carried no payload - reconnaissance is the dominant case.

threats.label: Heavy hexacopter bomber
threats.note: 5 drones with war-like stores were neutralised in 2025.

threats.label: FPV kamikaze
threats.note: Analogue video downlink, no GNSS - spoofing is useless, jamming the video link is the only soft-kill.

threats.label: Fibre-optic FPV (RF silent)
threats.note: RF COMPLETELY SILENT. The single most important recognition lesson in modern counter-drone warfare.

threats.label: Fixed-wing artillery spotter
threats.note: DRDO laser trials engaged a fixed-wing UAV at long range.

threats.label: Cheap decoy / saturation drone
threats.note: Swarm saturation element - designed to absorb effectors.

threats.label: Civilian drone (legal, Green zone)
threats.note: Registered UAS from the DGCA Certified RPAS list, operating legally.

threats.label: Bird / flock
threats.note: Primary false-alarm source. Radar-visible, RF-silent, thermally warm.

weather.label: Fog
weather.note: IMD present-weather code 45: fog/ice fog, sky invisible, no appreciable change.

light.label: Dusk
light.note: THERMAL CROSSOVER - target and background reach the same temperature; IR performance collapses.

threat_mix_weights.note: Weighted by the MoD 2025 neutralisation breakdown: 161 no-payload (recon), 72 narcotics (smuggling quad/hex), 5 war-like stores.

doctrine.note: The MoD 2025 review states that effective employment of own spoofers and jammers significantly countered the drone threat - soft kill is the doctrinal first line.

workload.note: NASA-TLX is a validated 6-axis workload instrument (mental, physical, temporal, effort, performance, frustration). The degradation curve below is the team's own calibration and is flagged as an assumption.
